# HexPiece 3.6.4

Your two notes on the Mochi fruit, and the first piece of its Awakening. **Not tested in game yet:** the build and all 13 test suites
pass, and each change was rendered in previews and checked against your notes and the reference GIFs.

## Buzz Cut Mochi: the heavy ball trails the elastic arm
Your words: "the end of the arm is heavier so ... the heavy end should always be after the mochi elastic part".
The white mochi arm now bows the way it is moving and the giant spiked ball trails after it, in the whirl, the raise and the slam.
At rest it sags under the ball's weight. In the slam it hangs down under the straight line to the ball (as your green line showed),
never arching up over it, and it always stays above the ground.

## Lotus Mochi Combo: knocked from donut to donut like a rag doll
Your words: "pushed in ragdoll from side to side depending where he was punched from basically from donut to donut carrying basically
being glued with each punch to the next, fast."
Once they are thrown up, they are never held still in the air:
- Four donuts appear round them, one after another. Each donut's fist strikes them from its side, stays stuck to them and carries them
  fast across to the next donut (about a sixth of a second), and that donut's fist knocks them on the other way. They zig-zag side to
  side and up, with a white burst and rings at every blow.
- They tumble like a rag doll the whole time: thrown over backward by the launch, then spun over the way each blow drives them.
- The top donut's giant fist then drives them straight down into the ground (splat, rocks, crater) as before. The whole combo is
  faster (about 4 seconds instead of 5).

## The Awakening (M): Trident Lacerations
M turns the Mochi Awakening on (a splash of dough and a magenta ring of Haki round you) and M again turns it off. While it is on:
- You hold **Mogura**, your trident, in your right hand (in third and first person).
- **Left click: Trident Lacerations**, five swings, one a click: a thrust (a jagged magenta burst on whoever it hits), a level slash (a
  bright magenta crescent), a spin all round (a spiral of black ink brushed on the ground), a rising slash (a black ink crescent edged in
  magenta) and a low sweep up. The fifth breaks through a raised shield and throws them straight up into the sky (a white ring on the
  ground, speed streaks).
- Z to N while awakened (Grilled Lance, Elastic Lasso, Oblivion, Power Mochi, Blazing Storm, Scorching Buzz Cut) come in the next
  version; for now pressing them says so.

With the Conqueror's Haki and Ryou on, the trident's blows throw the Conqueror's lightning.
